notes: The rule name LALPHA, read against the co-defined rule ALPHA = %x41-5A / %x61-7A, denotes a lowercase letter (%x61-7A); this is corroborated by the lowercase preference in Section 3.2.1 and the all-lowercase subtypes in Sections 5 and 7. Yet LALPHA is defined as the uppercase range %x41-5A, which appears to be an error for %x61-7A.
